column1: # OLLAMA-GATEWAY.DESIGN.md, G4; tds-utils Issue#460). One row per behavior
# libexec/probe.zsh exercises, twice: unconfined (the `control` column must
# hold, so no row can pass vacuously) and under sandbox/ollama-gateway.sb
# with the launcher's parameters (the `confined` column must hold).
# Columns, tab separated: check  confined  control  verb  target...
#   expectation  deny    the sandbox itself refused (EPERM); nothing else counts
#                permit  the sandbox did not refuse: success or any other error
#                skip    not exercised in this mode
#   target       $VAR names are the probe's parameters (--canary-file,
#                --ollama-port) and $UID; nothing else expands. The engine's
#                only outbound need is its runner on an ephemeral loopback
#                port, so every well-known port, the route's included, is
# Order matters for the keychain rows: the CLI is tried only after the
# framework row answered without a dialog (the probe enforces this).
